title: 第一卷 第19章 封王不合理那就赐婚吧第一卷 第20章 谋划稷下学宫圣女乖乖嫁过来
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
魏公公收起圣旨，满是褶子的脸上笑意更浓。
“恭喜魏王殿下，贺喜魏王殿下。”
赵辰安这才从巨大的错愕中回过神来，他连忙上前，扶住躬身的魏公公。
“公公客气了。”
我啥也没干啊，就遇了个刺，全程看戏，怎么就临危不乱，有王者之风了？
还直接封王了？
这魏王的名号，听着怎么就那么顺耳呢？
赵辰安脑子里一团乱麻，但他面上不动声色。
熟练地从袖中摸出一张银票，悄无声息地塞进了魏公公的手里。
魏公公手腕一翻，银票便消失无踪，脸上的笑容也真诚了几分。
“王爷，陛下还有口谕。”
“陛下说，您府上的牌匾也该换了，明日一早，内务府会派人送来新的‘魏王府’牌匾。”
说完，魏公公又行了一礼，便带着一众禁卫转身离去，干脆利落。
直到那一行人的身影彻底消失在府门外，李青鸾和乌兰雪才如梦初醒般围了上来。
“夫君，这……这就封王了？”
乌兰雪的小脸上满是不可思议。
李青鸾也蹙着秀眉，她比乌兰雪想得更多。
“父皇这一手，到底是什么意思？白天遇刺，晚上封王，这太反常了。”
赵辰安深吸一口气，压下心中的波澜。
他当然也觉得反常。

父皇这一连串的操作，根本不像是单纯的奖赏，更像是在……布局。
一场以他为棋子的大棋。
“不管父皇是什么意思，兵来将挡，水来土掩。”
赵辰安牵起二女的手，脸上恢复了那副随性的笑容。
“先别想那么多了，赶紧准备一下，明天咱们魏王府，可要热闹了。”
……
次日清晨，天还未亮，十六皇子府。
哦不，现在应该叫魏王府的门前，就已经车水马龙。
内务府的工匠们手脚麻利地换上了鎏金的“魏王府”
牌匾。
那三个大字在晨光下熠熠生辉，彰显着主人身份的尊贵。
赵辰安一身亲王蟒袍，带着乌兰雪和李青鸾，站在府门前迎客。
前来道贺的皇子公主，朝中大臣络绎不绝。
二皇子、四皇子、七皇子……
一个个平日里眼高于顶的兄弟，此刻都带着热情的笑容，亲自前来恭贺。
一些未出阁的公主，也结伴而来，好奇地打量着这位突然声名鹊起的十六弟。
整个京城，都因为这突如其来的封王而震动。
所有人都想看看，这位之前默默无闻，甚至被认为是修行废柴的十六皇子，究竟是何方神圣。
赵辰安应付自如，与每一位来客谈笑风生，滴水不漏。
乌兰雪和李青鸾一左一右，一个温婉可人，一个英姿飒爽，也为他赚足了颜面。

宴会从清晨一直持续到日暮，宾客尽欢。
content_en:
Eunuch Wei put away the imperial edict, and the smile on his wrinkled face became even stronger.
"Congratulations to His Highness the King of Wei, congratulations to His Highness the King of Wei."
Only then did Zhao Chenan come back to his senses from the huge shock. He quickly stepped forward and supported Eunuch Wei who was bowing.
"Father-in-law, you're welcome."
I didn't do anything, I was stabbed, and I watched the whole show. How could I be calm in the face of danger and act like a king?
And directly made him the king?
Why does the name of King Wei sound so pleasant to the ears?
Zhao Chenan's mind was in a mess, but his face remained calm.
Skillfully, he took out a banknote from his sleeve and quietly stuffed it into Eunuch Wei's hand.
Eunuch Wei flipped his wrist and the banknote disappeared without a trace, and the smile on his face became a little more sincere.
"Your Majesty, your Majesty still has a verbal message."
"Your Majesty said that the plaque on your residence should also be changed. Tomorrow morning, the Ministry of Internal Affairs will send someone to deliver a new plaque of 'Prince Wei's Palace'."
After saying that, Eunuch Wei bowed again, turned around and left with a group of guards, simply and neatly.
It wasn't until the group of people completely disappeared outside the mansion that Li Qingluan and Wu Lanxue surrounded them as if they were waking up from a dream.
"Husband, this...is this the title of king?"
Wu Lanxue's little face was full of disbelief.
Li Qingluan also frowned, she thought more than Wu Lanxue.
"What does the father's move mean? He was assassinated during the day and made king at night. This is too abnormal."
Zhao Chenan took a deep breath and suppressed the waves in his heart.
Of course he felt abnormal.
This series of operations by the father are not like a simple reward at all, but more like... a layout.
A grand chess game in which he was a pawn.
"No matter what my father means, the troops will stop us and the water will cover us."
Zhao Chenan held the two women's hands, and his casual smile returned to his face.
"Don't think so much now, and hurry up and get ready. Our Prince Wei's Mansion is going to be lively tomorrow."
…
Early the next morning, before dawn, the Sixteenth Prince's Mansion.
Oh no, there is already a lot of traffic in front of the door that should be called Prince Wei's Mansion.
The craftsmen of the Ministry of Internal Affairs quickly replaced the gilded "Prince Wei's Mansion"
plaque.
Those three big characters shined brightly in the morning light, demonstrating the dignity of the owner.
Zhao Chenan, dressed in a prince's python robe, stood in front of the mansion with Wu Lanxue and Li Qingluan to greet the guests.
There was an endless stream of princes, princesses, and ministers of the court and government who came to express their congratulations.
The second prince, the fourth prince, the seventh prince...
All the brothers who usually have high eyesight now come to congratulate in person with warm smiles.
Some princesses who had not left the palace also came together, curiously looking at the sixteenth brother who suddenly became famous.
The entire capital was shaken by this sudden kingship.
Everyone wants to see who this sixteenth prince, who was previously unknown and even considered a loser in cultivation, is.
Zhao Chenan handled the situation with ease, chatting and laughing with every visitor without missing a beat.
Wu Lanxue and Li Qingluan were on the left and right, one was gentle and pleasant, the other heroic, which also earned him enough face.
The banquet lasted from early morning to sunset, and the guests enjoyed themselves.
